text: Same as MSPDI Tasks, except that the WBS tree is given by Task.parentTaskUid and Task.siblingOrder. GRS makes ID, OutlineLevel, OutlineNumber and Summary from that tree each time it writes MSPDI.

The task groups, each shown as one row of the task group panel and one row of the chart. taskGroupMembers says which tasks each task group holds. When GRS reads an MSPDI file, it makes the task groups from the WBS.
Which task group each task belongs to: one entry per task, from taskUid to taskGroupId.
Same as MSPDI Project/UID. Before overwriting a file, GRS compares this value with the one in the file to tell whether the file holds the same document.

Same as MSPDI Project/MinutesPerDay: the length of one working day (1d) in minutes, 480 when absent. When the working times of a working day add up to a different total, GRS warns each time the document opens.

Same as MSPDI Project/DefaultStartTime: the time of day GRS gives a start that is set by the day (the start of a Task or a BaselineTask, actualStart, resume, project.startDate); 08:00:00 when absent. A milestone's start gets defaultFinishTime instead.

Same as MSPDI Project/DefaultFinishTime: the time of day GRS gives a finish that is set by the day (the finish of a Task or a BaselineTask, actualFinish, stop, deadline, project.statusDate) and a milestone's start; 17:00:00 when absent.
Carried MSPDI values of this element, under their MSPDI names.
Carried MSPDI elements under this one, each written back in its place.
Same as MSPDI Calendar/BaseCalendarUID: the calendar this one inherits from. Carried: GRS counts only the days this calendar itself lists.
Same as MSPDI Exception/TimePeriod/FromDate: the first day of the exception. GRS reads only the date and writes T00:00:00.
Same as MSPDI Exception/TimePeriod/ToDate: the last day of the exception, included. GRS reads only the date and writes T23:59:00.

Same as MSPDI Exception/Type. Any value is accepted, but GRS counts only a one-off exception (9, absent, or 1 with recurrencePeriod absent or 1); other exceptions are carried. Write 1 for an exception you add.
Same as MSPDI WorkingTime/ToTime. 00:00:00 means 24:00, the end of the day.

Same as MSPDI Task. GRS reads the progress state with these checks, first match wins: no actualStart, not started; actualFinish set, finished; resumeValid false, suspended with no resume date; resume set, suspended with a resume date; otherwise in progress.
Same as MSPDI Task/CalendarUID. Carried: working days are counted with project.calendarUid.
Same as MSPDI Task/ActualStart. Absent means the task is not started.
Same as MSPDI Task/Stop: the end of the actual work so far on a task that is in progress or suspended. GRS omits stop once actualFinish is set.
Same as MSPDI Task/ActualFinish. Present only on a finished task; a percentComplete of 100 does not mean finished.
Same as MSPDI Task/Resume: on a suspended task, when the remaining work is planned to restart.
Same as MSPDI Task/ResumeValid. On a task with actualStart and no actualFinish, false means suspended with no resume date decided, even if resume holds a date.

Same as MSPDI Task/PercentComplete, except that GRS recalculates the value from the dates when opening a GRS JSON file: actual working minutes (actualStart to actualFinish, or to stop) over planned working minutes (start to finish), times 100, rounded; it can exceed 100. With no planned working minutes, as on a milestone, the value is 100 once actualFinish is set and 0 before.
Same as MSPDI PredecessorLink/LinkLag: in tenths of a minute, whatever lagFormat says; absent means no lag. In working days, one day is project.minutesPerDay minutes (480 when that is absent).

Same as MSPDI PredecessorLink/LagFormat. GRS counts the lag only when this is 7 (working days), 5 (hours) or 3 (minutes); with any other unit the lag is only shown and carried. GRS writes the unit the lag was typed in.
Same as MSPDI Resource/CalendarUID. Carried: working days are counted with project.calendarUid.
Carried MSPDI values, keyed by their MSPDI names.
One carried MSPDI element, kept whole and written back in its place.
